create_LayerwiseOffloadManager: create a LayerwiseOffloadManager to offload transformer layer weights from GPU to pinned CPU memory with async prefetch
build_OffloadableDiTMixin: build an OffloadableDiTMixin subclass to enable layerwise CPU offload on a DiT model via server arguments
run_prefetch_layer: run prefetch_layer to asynchronously copy a specific layer's weights from CPU to GPU before forward pass
test_release_layer: test release_layer to free a layer's GPU weights back to CPU placeholders after forward pass completes
summarize_iter_materialized_weights: summarize iter_materialized_weights to yield real weight tensors from CPU buffers even when offload is active
